title: fix(console): record tabs join the design mode; list draft actions read Reset / Update view
body:
Fixes #36737
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 管理员在记录页进入「设计布局」后，页签行直接变成可拖动、隐藏、改名的编辑器，页面顶部只有一条紫色横条；「⋯」里不再有「配置页签」。列表在设计模式下改了排序等，右侧按钮从「放弃 / 保存」改为「重置 / 更新视图」。
- 属于「设计模式」史诗：按维护者「照 Twenty 归类」的裁决，消除记录页两条保存横条叠在一起的问题。
- 页签草稿和菜单、页头按钮一起由设计模式的「保存」写入、「取消」丢弃；保存失败时设计模式会提示并保留草稿，不会写坏数据，合并后可整体回滚。
- 无

## What changes

- **Record tabs join the design mode.** `useRecordTabsConfig` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordTabsConfig.tsx`) no longer has an entry or a bar of its own. While the design mode is on, on a record page where the old gates hold (workspace admin who may author metadata, desktop full page, not a drawer or pane, not an authored page, and on an installed object the customization-door wall), the tab row is `RecordTabsEditor` in place. The draft is staged with `useDesignModeChange` under `record-tabs:OBJECT` (one staged change per object, beside `object-pins:OBJECT` and the app menu), so it survives a move to another page of the app. Its `commit` is the existing `saveRecordTabs` (own package `relatedLists`, or the base's paired `.custom` object extension through `saveObjectExtensionArrangement`), so both save paths are unchanged and are now called by the mode's 「保存」. The mode's 「取消」 drops it. An edit back to where the editor opened unstages it. The editor's controls stay off until its lazily loaded metadata client has arrived, and while the mode saves.
- **Removed:** `RecordTabsConfigBar`, `RECORD_TABS_CONFIG_ACTION` (`sys_configure_tabs`) and its ⋯ item in `RecordDetailView.tsx`, the bar's top offset for the shared chrome, and the tabs' own unsaved-edits guard (the mode's guard covers leaving the app). The Studio gates are now read only while the mode is on, so a record page outside the mode reads no package list for this.
- **List draft actions renamed, not gated.** `ListDraftActions` reads 「重置 / 更新视图」 (en: Reset / Update view) by changing the values of the existing keys `console.objectView.draft.discard` and `console.objectView.draft.save` in all eleven packs (zh-Hant regenerated by `gen:zh-hant`). No key is added or removed. The menu keeps 「保存到这个视图」 and 「另存为我的视图」. `ObjectView` never gated the draft on the design mode, so there is no refusal to remove; a new pin holds that the actions stay live under the mode's bar.
- Docs: `layout/designMode.tsx`'s module doc names the record tabs among the staged surfaces and the list's view actions as outside the mode. No `content/docs/**` or `skills/**` page teaches 「配置页签」 as a separate entry (searched both for `Configure tabs` and `配置页签`: zero hits).
- The existing ruling at `designMode.tsx` (a dashboard's and a report's editors stay outside the mode and exclude it, #36692) is untouched. The #36363 ruling (4) rename gate in the tabs editor is kept.

Files to read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordTabsConfig.tsx`, the `useRecordTabsConfig` hook: the staged value carries `packageId`, `mode`, `catalog`, `initial` and `draft`, so the mode's Save can write it from any page of the app. The commit closes over the metadata client captured at the edit.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`: the ⋯ item and the bar are removed. `tabsConfig.active` now means "the mode is on and this object's tabs may be arranged here".
3. `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`: two values per pack.

Two-minute check: in the showcase app as admin, open an account record and choose 功能展示 ▾ → 设计布局. Expected: one purple bar, a tab row of draggable chips, and no 「配置页签」 under ⋯. Hide a tab, press 保存, and the tab is gone for everyone.

## Tests

New pins (#36737), each in the component's existing harness file as a top-level `describe`, except the record page pin, which has its own file named for the card:
- `views/__tests__/RecordTabsConfig-36499.test.tsx`: the harness now mounts the real `useDesignModeController` and `DesignModeBar`. The tab row is the editor under the one bar, with no tabs bar of its own. The mode's 保存 writes the tabs draft together with another staged change, once and in the order staged (own package: `save object account` with `{ mode: 'draft', packageId: 'app.crm', ifNoneMatch: '*' }`, then `publish`), and leaves the mode. 取消 drops the draft and writes nothing. The draft survives leaving the page and coming back. The #36499 cases are kept and rewritten for the mode, and leaving the app now asks with the mode's message.
- `views/__tests__/RecordTabsConfigInstalled-36499.test.tsx`: the mode's 保存 writes the installed object's `.custom` extension (`ensure` → `save object_extension lead` in `app.hotcrm.custom` → `publish`). 取消 sends no ensure and no write.
- `views/RecordDetailView.designModeTabs-36737.test.tsx` (new): the real `RecordDetailView` on a full page. In the mode the tab row is the editor with one bar, and ⋯ has no 「Configure tabs」. Out of the mode (the control), the page's own tab row is drawn and ⋯ has no entry either.
- `views/ListDraftActions.noSave-35955.test.tsx`: through the real packs, zh reads 重置 / 更新视图 and the menu keeps 保存到这个视图 and 另存为我的视图. en reads Reset / Update view, and the narrow face is one Update view whose menu holds Reset.
- `views/ObjectView.footerCalculationDraft-36194.test.tsx`: under an entered design mode, the list draft's actions are drawn and live. The mode's 保存 stays off, 「保存到这个视图」 writes `sys_personal_view` on its own, and the mode stays on.

Ablation, run once and not kept: on the committed fix, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the tabs change's `saveRecordTabs(` commit with a no-op (anchor x1 → x0, blob fedff77c → cc563012). Both 保存 pins went red (`Tests 2 failed | 13 passed`). The file was restored to the HEAD blob fedff77c, and `git diff HEAD` was empty afterwards. The subject resolves from `src` through a relative import, so no `dist` leg applies.

<details><summary>Local readings (head 48b24db8e)</summary>

- Card test files (5): `Test Files 5 passed`, `Tests 29 passed`. The first run had 1 red: the record page pin waited on a pluralized name. The fix waits on the tab's control instead.
- app-shell tests that import the touched modules (RecordTabsConfig*, recordTabs*, ListDraftActions, designMode*, DesignModeBar, RecordDetailView, ObjectView harness): `Test Files 119 passed (119)`, `Tests 1106 passed (1106)`, lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n test`: `Test Files 110 passed (110)`. The first run was red on `zh-hant-generated.test.ts` because I had hand-edited zh-Hant. It is now regenerated with `gen:zh-hant`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check`: both scripts echoed, exit 0.
- `node ui/scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs`: exit 0. `node ui/scripts/check-i18n-en-drift.mjs`: exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` (41 families): 39 exit 0. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` had 2 timeouts at 15 s under contention (`check-i18n-call-site-keys.test.ts`, `js-comment-mask-returns-interpolation-9424.test.ts`); re-run alone: `Test Files 2 passed`, `Tests 160 passed`. `pnpm check:type-check-debt` exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: its closure build did not get the shared verify lock). NOT MEASURED locally and left to CI. `--ran` reconciliation: 41 derived, 41 run, 0 UNRUN.
- Locale key sets, source-level: en and zh-Hans have 5013 leaves before (b01d8f97) and after, with 0 key-path differences. The only diff per pack is the two values.

</details>

## Verification

Browser, showcase app, admin, at 1440×900 in zh-CN, against a per-agent stack (`--fresh` backend and the Console from this branch's source):
- Account record 「Umbrella Health」 → 设计布局: one bar (`design-mode-bar` + `record-tabs-config-bar` count = 1). The tab row reads ⠿联系人 原始包, ⠿字段动物园 · Lookup → Account 原始包, ⠿字段动物园 · 查找 → 客户（多值） 原始包, ⠿审批, ⠿动态, with 已隐藏 无 and 调整字段分组. This is an installed object, so the `.custom` path applies. ⋯ reads 刷新 / 分享 / 更改负责人 / 删除, with no 配置页签.
- Task list → 设计布局 → 排序 → 截止日期: the condition row ends with 重置 and 更新视图 ▾ under the mode's bar. The menu reads 「未保存的改动: 排序 / 另存为我的视图」; this shipped view offers no save-to-view for this reader, as before. The mode's 保存 stays off.

Screenshots were taken in the run and are held by the seat.

## Acceptance notes

- The card's text says the split menu keeps 「保存为我的视图」. The served zh label is 「另存为我的视图」 (`saveAsMyView`), and it is kept unchanged.
- Three keys now have no call site: `designMode.recordTabs.entry`, `.leaveUnsaved` and `.saveFailed`. They are left in the pack, because removing a key from the published `@object-ui/i18n` pack would narrow it, which is outside this card's `Clause-②: no`. `designMode.recordTabs.title` stays live as the editor region's accessible name. The dead-key sweep is report-only.
- `leadsMenu: true` in `@object-ui/components`' page header (`containers.tsx`) now has no producer: the removed ⋯ item was its only one. Its pin in `components/src/__tests__/page-header-overflow-close-36499.test.tsx` uses a fixture and still holds. This is a zero-pull mechanism, not filed.
- While the mode is on, a record page with editable tabs draws in the default order, with the reader's own arrangement set aside, as the old edit state did, so the preview is what Save writes for everyone.
